summary: M0 model-only verdict: CONTAIN @ 0.92. Confirmed account takeover for s.demir@aegean.edu. A lab-admin account authenticated from 45.142.10.9 (Cloudvault VPS, Frankfurt, DE) via vpn-edge-01, flagged as a vulnerable appliance. MFA was approved once (21:31, mfa_prompt_count=1) and then seven consecutive portal/LMS sign-ins occurred with zero MFA prompts, indicating MFA bypass/session reuse after initial auth. Access pattern is automated (alternating portal/lms every ~5 minutes) from a foreign VPS, inconsistent with normal lab-admin use. No mail events to explain the signals. Containment is warranted: disable the account, reset credentials/revoke sessions, and investigate the vulnerable VPN appliance.
limitations: M0 ablation: Nemotron alone, no tools, no Critic, no Risk Gate, no DQ. Not a product configuration.
